subject: Money
title: Present Bias
description: A micro-lesson that makes Present Bias usable.

hook.text: Offered $100 today or $110 tomorrow, most people grab the $100. We massively overvalue the present.

buildup.text: Present bias means we discount future rewards steeply. A dollar now feels worth more than $1.50 later.

discovery.text: This is why saving is hard. Retirement is decades away; the new phone is right here.

twist.text: Our ancestors needed present bias. Eat now or starve. But in a world of credit cards, it bankrupts us.

climax.text: Every financial plan fights present bias. Automation works because it removes the choice in the moment.

punchline.text: Your future self is a stranger you rob.

quiz.question: What does present bias cause people to do?
